static_traits.name: Wang Jing
static_traits.gender: Female（资料存在not一致：自述为Mother，但表单标注为male）
static_traits.family_status: 有两个Female儿；丈夫从事电信行业
static_traits.social_status: 有人际支持网络（朋友群体），但对分享母职困扰感到not适
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems occurred before; has not received psychotherapy/咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯，能合作；情绪以内疚与Self-doubt为主，Neutral attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 因为Female儿not喜欢和我一起进行像登山这样的活动，我作为Mother感到挫败与not够好，并为坚持自己喜欢的活动而内疚。
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的not足感与内疚感已使我overwhelmed，希望缓解这些感受，探索更平衡的亲子互动方式并重建对母职的信心。

core_beliefs: 只有完全迎合孩子的兴趣，我才算合格

special_situations.event: Female儿明确表示对登山等户外探险not感兴趣
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子not喜欢我的兴趣，就说明我作为Mother做错了或not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁与Female儿讨论并尝试让她们参与not同活动，试图通过改变活动来证明自己称职
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她们not喜欢和我一起登山，说明我是个not称职的Mother

special_situations.event: 每当计划户外活动、AnticipationFemale儿会not感兴趣时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果她们再次not愿意参加，就证明我的育儿方式失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少计划或降低活动强度，同时在内心not断自我批评以避免被再度拒绝
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will surely hate this plan, and I will be the 'bad mom' again

special_situations.event: 想到朋友圈里其他Mother“似乎都处理得很好”时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现出困扰，do not人会认为我在母职上失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids confiding in friends or seeking support, trying to keep problems bottled up inside
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她们会觉得我很失败、是个not好的Mother

special_situations.event: 家庭游戏之夜让全家都感到愉快、彼此连接时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连接not是通过我热爱的户外活动达成，就not算真正的母Female亲密
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Belittles the significance of such positive experiences, continuing to demand of herself with high standards that relationships must be built through outdoor means
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not算真正的亲密，这not能证明我做得好

core_conflict.wish: 渴望与Female儿建立亲密而被认同的母Female连接，并在共同活动中被需要与接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被Female儿拒绝、被视为失败的Mother，从而失去自我价值
defense_goal: 通过自责与迎合来避免被评判与拒绝
Maintains surface control and restraint, reducing exposure of vulnerability to gain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、需要证明自己的Mother
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔或会评判的他人/Female儿

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被比较且显得失败的Mother
object_relations.object_representation: “完美”的其他Mother/朋友圈中的评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they have confided motherhood troubles to friends or thinking of friends 'all handling it well'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为朋友会看not起自己、把自己视为失败的Mother（移情：将内在的自我批评投向他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses in a vague, reserved manner, downplaying own needs, avoiding deeply unfolding personal vulnerable experiences.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当Female儿拒绝或not愿参与户外活动时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets external rejection as own failure and turns to harsh self-blame (transference: internalizing disappointment and frustration)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以道歉和Self-denial的语气回应，减少表达自己的需求与喜好。

manifestations: 与Female儿兴趣not同导致的亲密感缺失与疏离感
担心在朋友中暴露脆弱，被视为失败而回避倾诉
outcomes: 亲子连接感下降、Increased subjective sense of isolation

manifestations: Torn between persisting in one's interest (mountaineering) and fulfilling mother-role expectations
以“应该”为自我要求：应优先满足Female儿兴趣
outcomes: 内疚与自责，体验到选择Freedom受限
价值冲突导致情绪困扰与决策犹豫

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁Self-doubt与自我批评（“我是坏妈妈/not够好”）
在亲友面前克制表达困扰，过度谨慎地维护形象

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 假设朋友会认为自己失败，因此避免求助
将内在的羞耻与自责体验归因为他人的潜在评判

exception_events.target_problem: 在与Female儿建立连接的情境中，来访者通常会尝试以户外探险（如登山）作为主要方式，但Female儿not感兴趣，从而引发其挫败与内疚、Self-doubt。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在家庭游戏之夜的具体时刻，大家都感到愉快并有效地建立了亲子连接，与以往围绕户外活动的挫败体验not同。
exception_events.reason: 情境not同：选择贴近Female儿兴趣、压力较低且更具协作性的活动形式，使互动更轻松、可被Female儿接纳。

positive_force: Has stable social support resources (a supportive friend network)
Willing to communicate and try compromise (able to propose gentler options such as picnics and short walks)
能觉察并寻求帮助（主动来访求助）
已有成功的亲子互动经验（家庭游戏之夜）
Love and investment in outdoor activities, which can be converted into resources for shared parent-child experiences
negative_force: Self-worth highly attaches to role norms and external evaluation ('a good mother should...')
认知歪曲显著：个人化、读心术、negate积极、灾难化/过度概括
Shame about and avoidance of seeking support (worrying about being seen by friends as a failure)
Interprets differences in interests as relationship failure, weakening the possibility of diverse connections

target_behavior.behavior: 计划亲子活动时出现强烈的内疚与Self-doubt（自责与负性自动思维反复出现）
antecedent: 计划户外活动时AnticipationFemale儿not感兴趣
与“其他Mother都处理得很好”的比较念头出现后
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化的角色信念：好Mother应当优先满足孩子兴趣；若兴趣not一致即等同失败
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与被评判的Anxiety，维持表面上的控制感与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Reduces the flexibility and satisfaction of parent-child interaction, increases self-blame and frustration, weakens persistence in and sharing of their own interests

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向朋友寻求支持或分享母职困扰
antecedent: 想到朋友“都很有条理/处理得很好”
被询问是否与朋友讨论相关话题
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears that exposing vulnerability will be seen as failure, externalizing inner shame experience as others' potential judgment
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与negate反馈，短期内降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of social support，孤立感与负性自我评价维持甚至加重
